slices.description: The WHAT: the 25 not-closed roadmap features to allocate - identity, state, WSJF/RICE, spec path, hard blocking edges, engineer sequencing directive, and what duration data honestly exists.
The WHO: per-host capability, declared scheduler caps and their freshness, current load, availability, delivery track record and host-specific constraints for ARIELLAS, OLAMNIT and GAVRIELLA.

The HOW: coop CRDT protocol v2 and the W1-W14 work protocol, the scheduler CPM/PERT contract, pipeline stage order, marathon advisory semantics, safe-restart and sync-round obligations, and the known defects in the tooling itself.
